title: The Foreclosed Keel
logline: A predatory maritime bank forecloses on a multi-generational ore freighter whose bridge is barricaded by its founding family, hiring a pilot to break the repo blockade.

roles.description: Born in the forward cabin of the freighter sixty years ago; weathered, fierce, refusing to yield the ship to banking bailiffs.
Contracted by maritime lenders to seize indebted hulls; heavily armed, methodical, unmoved by family sentiment.
A high-acceleration gunboat clamping the freighter's stern with magnetic mooring locks.
The commercial credit trust that purchased the family's mortgaged fuel debt at a predatory discount.
The loose brotherhood of independent family-operated cargo vessels watching the confrontation from nearby slipways.
A sprawling, patched bulk ore transport that houses twelve family members and three generations of mining gear.
The station judicial registry dock where vessel property liens and repossession warrants are contested.

public_situation: Armed repossession marshals clamp the docking collars of {role:family_freighter}, preparing to breach the airlocks under a bank foreclosure order.
private_truth: {role:banking_syndicate} forged an acceleration clause in the family's mortgage contract to liquidate the hull ahead of a lucrative scrap metal spike.

beats.public_change: Station security cordons the pier while marshals sever external power lines to the family vessel.

missions.reason: She needs structural ferrite delivered to the dorsal cargo hatch to weld barricades across the airlock before the repo crew breaches the hull.
missions.private_fact: She is hiding her teenage granddaughter in the bilge to prevent bank bailiffs from placing her in indentured transit custody.

beats.public_change: The matriarch transmits the ship's original mortgage scroll over open channels, revealing an altered payment schedule.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to scan the admiralty court's registry archive and extract the authentic mortgage document stamped forty years ago.
missions.private_fact: Her late husband signed the mortgage amendment while hospitalized with nitrogen narcosis without understanding the terms.

beats.public_change: The bank hires strike-breaking skiffs to board the freighter's engine bay from open space, bypassing the welded airlocks.

missions.reason: She needs the privateer boarding skiffs destroyed in open flight and their electronic override bypass core recovered.
missions.private_fact: The freighter's main reactor is running on bypass circuits and could detonate if breached by boarding lasers.

beats.public_change: {role:marshal_corvette} powers main railguns, preparing to sever the freighter's cockpit module directly from the spine.

missions.reason: She needs the marshal's corvette disabled so her family can ignite their main engines and break out of the station slipway.
missions.private_fact: The repo marshal hails mid-fight offering a fifty percent split of the vessel's refined copper cargo if the pilot withdraws.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the marshal's gunboat and protects the family.
resolutions.summary: The marshal's gunboat is disabled. {role:family_freighter} breaks mooring and escapes into independent space, keeping the multi-generational family together.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary broke through bank gunboats to help an asteroid family save their multi-generational home ship from repossession.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the marshal's bounty and allows the seizure.
resolutions.summary: The freighter is boarded and seized. {role:banking_syndicate} strips the hull for scrap, and the family is broken up into bonded mining labor.

consequences.public_summary: Dockworkers whisper of a pilot who took bank scrip to let repossession marshals strip a family of their ancestral home ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the mission line or the reactor is breached.
resolutions.summary: Marshals breach the vessel's hull. The matriarch is arrested, and {role:family_freighter} is auctioned off to pay accumulated legal penalties.

loose_threads.detail: The exchange board lists forward contracts for heavy freighter hull scrap surging forty percent, funded by the bank's investment arm.
The acceleration clause rider on the bank warrant bears an electronic signature timestamped after the registry courthouse closed for the holiday.
The transponder code on {role:marshal_corvette} is registered to an offshore mercenary firm rather than official system bailiffs.

radio_hooks: Admiralty court issues repossession warrant against unregistered cargo transport in Berth Four.
Freighter clan captains stage horn-blowing protest outside banking district offices.
Scrap metal syndicates predict surge in decommissioned hull supply this quarter.

voice_direction.freighter_matriarch: Gravelly, deep, and fiercely maternal. Speaks of her rusty freighter like a living matriarch, refusing to concede an inch of hull plating to bank agents.
voice_direction.repo_marshal: Cold, professional, and completely detached. Delivers legal notices of eviction and violence with the calm efficiency of a customs clerk reviewing shipping manifests.
